'''[[Dame Natalie]]''' is one of the ten {{Card|Knights}} from {{Set|Dark Ages}}. Like other [[Knight]]s, this is an [[Action]]-[[Attack]]-[[Knight]] that performs a [[trashing attack]], but the card also allows you to [[gainer|gain]] a card costing up to {{Cost|3}}.

It can be worth it to prioritize Dame Natalie if the Kingdom contains strong {{Cost|3}} cards that you want multiple copies of, such as [[village (card category)|villages]] or other key engine pieces. The gain ability provides immediate deck improvement alongside the standard Knight attack, making this one of the more versatile Knights in the pile.
